question: Given 20 transitions and 13 clean controls, what difference could this study ever have detected?
binding_constraint: n_transitions = 20, not the number of controls. Even 200 controls only reaches 80% power if the transition rate is ~93%. More placebo sampling cannot fix this; only more transitions can.
honest_reading: This study did not detect a difference and was never powered to detect anything short of a near-total one. Power at the observed 18.5pp gap is 0.16. The correct statement is "underpowered, difference not resolved", NOT "no difference exists". The gap runs in the predicted direction; the study cannot say whether it is real.
